findings: Native PDF vector incspection confirms that the close rows B/C and D/E are distinct in source space.
Compact graphics near these rows are not represented consistently as one PDF rectangle per physical column.
Several locations in the D/E band contain multiple compact black vector primitives around one structural graphic. Primitive-count must not be used as instance-count.
At C row, native compact primitives are sparse/asymmetric relative to the human-approved column layout; therefore grid-nearest vector primitive selection is not safe for tight bboxes.
HSSS text or fixed text offsets remain secondary semantic evidence only and are not valid footprint coordinates.
promotion_rules: One visible physical column footprint maps to one detection instance, regardless of how many PDF primitives form it.
Tight bbox must follow the visible source footprint, including any local eccentricity; never snap to grid or footing center.
Two close distinct visible footprints at an expansion/separation joint remain two instances.
No bbox is promoted to GT from this vector-mining pass alone.
next_gate: Visually reconcile each human-approved instance to the native-PDF render and emit one tight source-page box per visible footprint; then run completeness and duplicate QA.
